theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (u v : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Eucl (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn u K volume) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn v K volume) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), ∫ x in U, u x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume = ∫ x in U, v x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))), x ∈ U → u x = v x
